+  # `with C1 <- E1 [, C2 <- E2 …] do BODY [else ARMS] end` — parsed into a `With`
+  # node carrying the clause list, body, and `else` arms (empty when absent). The
+  # intent is kept here; the desugar to nested `case` happens at lowering (ADR-0039).
+  def parse_with(ts Vec(Tok)) Parse
+  def parse_with(ts)
+    case parse_wclauses(ts, []) do
+      WCs(clauses, [TKw("do") | r2]) ->
+        case parse_bp(0, skip_nl(r2)) do
+          P(body, r3) -> parse_with_else(clauses, body, skip_nl(r3))
+        end
+    end
+  end
+
+  # the `<-` clause list, comma-separated, up to `do`.
+  def parse_wclauses(ts Vec(Tok), acc Vec(WithClause)) WClausesRes
+  def parse_wclauses(ts, acc)
+    case parse_pat(ts) do
+      PP(pat, [TOp("<-") | r1]) ->
+        case parse_bp(0, r1) do
+          P(src, [TComma | r2]) -> parse_wclauses(skip_nl(r2), [WC(pat, src) | acc])
+          P(src, rest) -> WCs(rev_wclauses([WC(pat, src) | acc], []), rest)
+        end
+    end
+  end
+
+  # `else ARMS end` -> the arms; a bare `end` -> no `else` (empty arms).
+  def parse_with_else(cs Vec(WithClause), body Expr, ts Vec(Tok)) Parse
+  def parse_with_else(cs, body, [TKw("else") | r4])
+    case parse_arms(r4, []) do
+      ARs(arms, r5) -> parse_postfix(With(cs, body, arms), r5)
+    end
+  end
+  def parse_with_else(cs, body, [TKw("end") | r4]) := parse_postfix(With(cs, body, []), r4)
+
+  def rev_wclauses(Vec(WithClause), Vec(WithClause)) Vec(WithClause)
+  def rev_wclauses([], out) := out
+  def rev_wclauses([c | rest], out) := rev_wclauses(rest, [c | out])
+
   # an arm body may begin on the next line (`PAT -> <nl> body`); skip the newline(s)
   # so `parse_bp` sees the body, not an empty expression.
   def skip_nl(ts Vec(Tok)) Vec(Tok)
